title: Ava's decision

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm ready.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm ready.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't think so. You'll be fine without me though. I promise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think so. You'll be fine without me though. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not judging you. But your actions show the kind of person you have become.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not judging you. But your actions show the kind of person you have become.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not sure I want to live in a world where corporations, money and capital can change someone's heart the way they've changed yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I want to live in a world where corporations, money and capital can change someone's heart the way they've changed yours.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I thought I knew how this world worked, but you showed me that even if CorpSec makes the rules, they can't control what's in people's hearts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought I knew how this world worked, but you showed me that even if CorpSec makes the rules, they can't control what's in people's hearts.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With Clem, you turned metal and concrete into flowers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With Clem, you turned metal and concrete into flowers.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With Mica, you resisted when people tried to scare you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With Mica, you resisted when people tried to scare you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: And they certainly couldn't control what was in YOURS.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And they certainly couldn't control what was in YOURS.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You have given me hope. Hope that whatever lies ahead for me, this world is where I belong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have given me hope. Hope that whatever lies ahead for me, this world is where I belong.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With The Crusty Punks and Gamova, you obeyed the Corps when they asked for your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With The Crusty Punks and Gamova, you obeyed the Corps when they asked for your help.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With Clem, you reported illegal activities to the authorities and crushed rebellions before they could bloom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With Clem, you reported illegal activities to the authorities and crushed rebellions before they could bloom.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I understand that you did what you had to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand that you did what you had to.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I know. I understand all your choices - I was there. I was with you. But I don't think I want to return to THIS world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. I understand all your choices - I was there. I was with you. But I don't think I want to return to THIS world.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll accept the connection, and my mind will be uploaded to the new body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll accept the connection, and my mind will be uploaded to the new body.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If there is a way back to you, I will find it. And when I find you, I'm giving you the biggest, squeeziest hug of your life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If there is a way back to you, I will find it. And when I find you, I'm giving you the biggest, squeeziest hug of your life.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll delete the last link to my physical form. I will reject the connection to the new body Thaddeus had waiting for me. I'll be lost in the Nets... In that endless sea of night. And I'll find peace.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll delete the last link to my physical form. I will reject the connection to the new body Thaddeus had waiting for me. I'll be lost in the Nets... In that endless sea of night. And I'll find peace.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I know. But I trust Thaddeus. And I trust you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. But I trust Thaddeus. And I trust you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I know this is real. There IS a body waiting for me, if I want it. The decision is not whether I trust Thaddeus... it is whether I want to come back and live a life in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know this is real. There IS a body waiting for me, if I want it. The decision is not whether I trust Thaddeus... it is whether I want to come back and live a life in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You'll be fine without me. I promise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll be fine without me. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Goodbye...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes. I'm ready.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I'm ready.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't think it's my fate to die today. If Thaddeus built the road that led us here, I believe he built something for us at the end of it too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think it's my fate to die today. If Thaddeus built the road that led us here, I believe he built something for us at the end of it too.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I will find you. And I will thank you, in person... And then... I'll probably try to kiss you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will find you. And I will thank you, in person... And then... I'll probably try to kiss you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Nivalis is a city of dreams. In mine, we are together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nivalis is a city of dreams. In mine, we are together.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I've been watching you for a long time now. Watching the choices you make, and the way this city has shaped you into the person you have become.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been watching you for a long time now. Watching the choices you make, and the way this city has shaped you into the person you have become.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well. There it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well. There it is.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes. Preserved, but lifeless. We found... me. But my body is a shell. It's the least life a body can have without being dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Preserved, but lifeless. We found... me. But my body is a shell. It's the least life a body can have without being dead.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: My mind, yes. My brain still works, and the Cryogenic technology that broadcasts and digitizes my thoughts is functional. The system allows me to be your Automata, but...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My mind, yes. My brain still works, and the Cryogenic technology that broadcasts and digitizes my thoughts is functional. The system allows me to be your Automata, but...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: This human body has been preserved for a long time... and preserved well. But it was never intended to be woken. This isn't a place to care for the sick. It is a tomb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This human body has been preserved for a long time... and preserved well. But it was never intended to be woken. This isn't a place to care for the sick. It is a tomb.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Perhaps... not. New subroutines are being unlocked as we speak. I am being made aware of another option.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps... not. New subroutines are being unlocked as we speak. I am being made aware of another option.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I see now. Thaddeus had a plan for me. He left me with an offer. I must make a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see now. Thaddeus had a plan for me. He left me with an offer. I must make a choice.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I can hear him in my head now... There is another body. I don't know what it is like, and I don't know where it is. But Thaddeus says I can go to it. I can LIVE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can hear him in my head now... There is another body. I don't know what it is like, and I don't know where it is. But Thaddeus says I can go to it. I can LIVE.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am still deciding. A new life... somewhere? Do I just trust Thaddeus and his plan? Did he really have this in mind all along? A way to give me my life back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am still deciding. A new life... somewhere? Do I just trust Thaddeus and his plan? Did he really have this in mind all along? A way to give me my life back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would love that. Good luck Ava!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would love that. Good luck Ava!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would love that. Good luck Ava!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would love that. Good luck Ava!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will I ever speak to you again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will I ever speak to you again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will I ever speak to you again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will I ever speak to you again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, good luck Ava. I hope you find your peace.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck Ava. I hope you find your peace.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, good luck Ava. I hope you find your peace.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, good luck Ava. I hope you find your peace.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel terrible...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel terrible...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have any regrets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have any regrets.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We don't know where it is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We don't know where it is?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We don't know where it is?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We don't know where it is?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will I ever see you again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will I ever see you again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will I ever see you again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will I ever see you again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Peace? I don't want you to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Peace? I don't want you to go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Peace? I don't want you to go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Peace? I don't want you to go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you ready, then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you ready, then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye, Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye, Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be waiting for you, Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be waiting for you, Ava.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll be waiting for you, Ava.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll be waiting for you, Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll hold you to that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll hold you to that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your body?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your body?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you are still alive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you are still alive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We can't... defrost you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can't... defrost you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then we failed...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then we failed...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's happening?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's happening?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What choice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What choice?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you'll just... disappear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you'll just... disappear?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But Thaddeus lied to us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But Thaddeus lied to us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your body is damaged?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your body is damaged?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you sure about this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure about this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can we still trust him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can we still trust him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I still believe in Thaddeus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still believe in Thaddeus.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We don't know if that body is still viable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We don't know if that body is still viable.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We don't know if that body is still viable.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We don't know if that body is still viable.
